name: A re-laid line (the route-moves test)
_doc: A second, different route (#542 'The route can move'; #551): longer (2.1 km), a right-hand bend of 150 m (60 degrees, 40 m spirals) then a left-hand reverse bend of 200 m (40 degrees), a 3 % climb and a long 1.5 % descent, and a water stop between the depot and the mine. The same timetable runs it: its stops are named, the run times come from the sim.
